name: Anne E. Lopez
stance: Opposes federal preemption of state online-safety and AI laws and backs federal frontier-AI safety regulation.

statements.text: States need the ability to respond quickly to emerging online threats impacting minors, whether that involves social media platforms, exploitative algorithms, artificial intelligence tools, or other digital harms.

Signed the 26-AG letter urging Congress to immediately establish comprehensive federal regulation and safety protocols for frontier AI, including mandatory federal oversight of safety testing, and to prohibit preemption of state law.
Joined a 36-AG letter to Congress opposing federal legislation that would bar states from enacting or enforcing AI laws.
